remaining_reasons: External-02 removes the prior third lower-left dash and has exactly two rows, but each returned row now contains three separate rounded gray blobs, six total. entries.positive_observation: The lower-left third mark is gone, exactly two upper rows remain, and the lower paper is largely blank. The high bald crown, short gray-brown side hair, dark eyebrows and thin rectangular spectacles remain; the face has one closed mouth and no added moustache or beard. The slight viewer-left pose, two red/gold collar patches, pale ribbon and one small silver-toned pendant remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a long stalk or clipping. The complete tilted frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The excessive gray blobs within the two rows are the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Precise spectacle-rim geometry, tiny pendant/ribbon details and note glyph identity are not fully readable at 65x67. Those uncertainties are not rejection reasons; two source mark groups per row versus three returned blobs per row are visibly distinct.
